name: Genius Invokation TCG Challenges Are Back! A full collection of Battlefield Valor Series Character Blind Boxes awaits!
description: Olah, card players! I'm here to play the card game with you once again! I heard that in Version 3.5 of Genshin Impact, there are three new Character Cards available: Eula, Sangonomiya Kokomi, and Kujou Sara. Did you get these cards yet? I've prepared new Genius Invokation TCG challenges for everyone! If you can successfully complete them, you will have the chance to win amazing merchandise rewards! Come check them out!
